## Environment

Commit, platform/device, Arabic or English, ordinary or demo entry, and relevant feature flags.

## Reproduction

Describe the starting state/reset and the smallest sequence that reproduces the problem.

## Expected and actual result

Link the applicable contract and include synthetic evidence only. Do not attach credentials,
private family details or real Child media.

## Evidence and impact

State whether this is a source finding, automated failure, browser observation or physical-device
observation. Explain how it affects the demonstration and any known workaround.
